## ✨ Highlights

- ⚡ **HAProxy on AWS-LC** - HAProxy now uses [AWS-LC](https://github.com/aws/aws-lc) instead of OpenSSL 3 for TLS: 1.4 to 7 times more TLS handshakes per second, the gap growing with the threads.
- 📦 **janusctl from apt** - `sudo apt-get install janusctl` from `apt.sw-servers.net`, for amd64 and arm64, on any Debian or Ubuntu release.

## 🔐 TLS: AWS-LC

OpenSSL 3 slows HAProxy down as soon as several threads handshake; HAProxy recommends AWS-LC. Measured with the same HAProxy 3.4.0, in connections per second:

| | 1 thread | 4 threads |
|---|---|---|
| TLS 1.3, ECDSA, X25519MLKEM768 (today's browsers) | 2273 → 4693 | 1585 → 9754 |
| TLS 1.3, RSA 2048 | 1613 → 2574 | 1590 → 6710 |
| TLS 1.3 session resumption | 2637 → 4989 | 2448 → 9762 |
| TLS 1.2, ECDHE-ECDSA | 3565 → 6046 | 2160 → 13862 |

- **Same behaviour**: certificates and crt-lists (runtime updates and Let's Encrypt renewals included), client certificates with CRLs, SNI, ALPN, TLS 1.2/1.3, X25519MLKEM768 and the TLS sample fetches.
- **Two visible differences**: `ssl_fc_curve` names the NIST curves `prime256v1`/`secp384r1` (OpenSSL: `SECP256R1`/`SECP384R1`), and without a cipher list TLS 1.2 prefers AES-128-GCM.
- **Refused keywords**: AWS-LC has no DHE, no engines or providers. `ssl-dh-param-file`, a cipher list made only of `DHE-*` ciphers, `X448`/`ffdhe*`/`brainpool*` curves, `client-sigalgs`, `ssl-security-level`, `ssl-mode-async`, `ssl-provider` and `ssl-propquery` are refused - [what to do instead](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/main/docs/haproxy-config.md#tls-aws-lc).
- Both architectures now build the same pinned TLS library (amd64 used Alpine's OpenSSL, arm64 a pinned one).

## 📦 janusctl

- **A Debian package** with every release, amd64 and arm64: a static binary, no dependency. From the repository:

  ```sh
  sudo install -d -m 0755 /etc/apt/keyrings
  sudo curl -fsSL https://apt.sw-servers.net/apt-sw-servers.net.gpg.asc -o /etc/apt/keyrings/apt-sw-servers.net.asc
  echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/apt-sw-servers.net.asc] https://apt.sw-servers.net/janus stable main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/janus.list
  sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install janusctl
  ```

  or as `janusctl_<version>_<arch>.deb` below.
- **`janusctl version`** prints its own version first, even when no node is reachable.

## ⚠️ Upgrade notes

- **Nodes**: before updating, check that `haproxy.cfg` uses none of the refused keywords above. Updated from the Controller (automatic revert, on by default) or with `janusctl lifecycle upgrade -wait-for-health`, a node whose HAProxy refuses its configuration goes back to its previous version on its own.
- **Controller**: no change.
